FloPlast 110mm black pipe clips offer essential support for soil and vent pipe installations, crucial for maintaining effective drainage systems. Constructed from robust uPVC, these clips feature double fixing holes to ensure a secure and stable attachment. They are engineered to provide reliable support for 110mm drainage pipes, with guidance for installation at maximum 2m vertical and 1m horizontal centres. This product is a practical choice for plumbers and trade professionals seeking durable pipework solutions.
